_doc: Procedural saga templates. Every run Saga (src/autoload/saga.gd) rolls a unique antagonist, ally, MacGuffin, scheme, personal thread (from your Motivation tag) and twist (from your Secret tag), then lays 7 story beats across random planets. Tokens: {player} {ally} {ally_job} {antagonist} {antagonist_title} {faction} {macguffin} {scheme} {personal} {lieutenant} {planet} {clue}.
quirks: ends every sentence with 'per my last transmission'
refers to themself in the third person
speaks only in questions when lying
keeps a pet cactus named Collateral
schemes: patent breathing in the outer colonies
repossess an entire planet's population as collateral
replace every news feed with one sponsored feeling
turn the Sprawl's dreams into ad inventory
privatise gravity and bill everyone for falling
sell the last natural sunrise to the highest bidder

macguffins.name: the Ledger of Everyone
macguffins.desc: a data-core listing every debt ever owed, including the Consortium's own

macguffins.name: a Founder's Cryo-Key
macguffins.desc: the master key to every cryo-vault in the Sprawl

macguffins.name: the Gravity Patent
macguffins.desc: the original filing that made falling a billable event

macguffins.name: the Last Free Breath
macguffins.desc: a sealed canister of 21st-century air, unowned by anyone

macguffins.name: Clause 9
macguffins.desc: the missing page of the Consortium Charter that limits their power

macguffins.name: the Source Jingle
macguffins.desc: the master recording behind every ad - and every sleeper trigger

clues: a Lumen raw feed nobody aired
a key-card shaped like a smile

find_sibling.label: your sibling
find_sibling.intro: A cryo-manifest lists a pod sold the same day as yours. The name is {personal}. Last seen on {planet}.
find_sibling.met: {personal} stares at you for a long time. "They told me you were collateral. They told me you were dead." They hand you a tracking code: "{antagonist} bought both our pods."

pay_debt.label: your debt
pay_debt.intro: Your Halcyon debt file was transferred to a private collector: {personal}, operating out of {planet}.
pay_debt.met: {personal} slides your debt file across the table. "I'll erase it. All of it. If you bring me {macguffin}. {antagonist} owes me more than you do."

burn_consortium.label: the resistance
burn_consortium.intro: A pirate broadcast keeps repeating one name: {personal}, a resistance cell leader on {planet}.
burn_consortium.met: {personal} doesn't trust you. Then they see your record on the Causality feed and laugh. "Fine. You're chaotic enough. {antagonist} is moving {macguffin} - help us take it."

get_famous.label: your rival
get_famous.intro: Lumen's hottest new star, {personal}, is filming on {planet} - and they're telling YOUR story, badly.
get_famous.met: {personal} rolls their eyes. "You're the real one? Ugh. Fine. The story's bigger than both of us: {antagonist} wants {macguffin}. Whoever exposes it gets prime time."

buy_a_planet.label: the land deed
buy_a_planet.intro: A planet deed auction is rigged by {antagonist}. The only honest broker left is {personal}, on {planet}.
buy_a_planet.met: {personal} taps a deed tablet. "Bring down {antagonist} and the auction goes public. Then any idiot can buy a planet. Even you."

twists.wanted_alias: The bounty on your old name was posted by {ally}. They needed you desperate enough to work for them.
twists.synth_air_allergy: Your 'allergy' was designed: {antagonist}'s air formula rejects unregistered lungs. You were the prototype.
twists.compulsive_liar: The wild story you tell about your past? It's true. You and {antagonist} built this scheme together, before the cryo.
twists.sleeper_agent: Your sleeper trigger is {antagonist}'s company jingle. {ally} has been humming it to steer you all along.
twists.kleptomaniac: You already stole {macguffin} once, before the freeze. {ally} knew - that's why they 'found' you.

beats.title: A Signal in the Static
beats.intro: QUACK intercepts a coded ping. "Someone named {ally} - a {ally_job} - knows about {macguffin}. They're on {planet}. Sounds like a trap. I love traps."
beats.talk: {ally} pulls you behind a noodle stand. "{antagonist}, {antagonist_title} at {faction}, plans to {scheme}. They need {macguffin}. We need to get there first. Start with {clue} - it was dumped on {next_planet}."

beats.title: Follow the Paper Trail
beats.intro: {clue} is somewhere on {planet}, guarded by people who get paid not to ask questions.
beats.done: You crack {clue} open. A name falls out: {lieutenant}, {antagonist}'s fixer.

beats.title: The Fixer
beats.intro: {lieutenant} runs {antagonist}'s dirty work out of {planet}. They won't come quietly.
beats.done: {lieutenant} drops a vault key with the {faction} logo. It's warm. Ugh.

beats.title: Hostile Acquisition
beats.intro: {macguffin} is stored on {planet}. Security is 'premium tier'.
beats.done: You hold {macguffin} - {macguffin_desc}. Every Consortium scanner in the sector just blinked.

beats.title: The Fine Print
beats.intro: {ally} wants to meet on {planet}. "Bring {macguffin}. Come alone. Well, bring the duck."

beats.title: Hostile Takeover
beats.intro: {antagonist} is on {planet}, preparing to {scheme}. This ends now. Probably expensively.
beats.done: {antagonist} is down. {macguffin} hums in your hands. The whole Sprawl is watching the Lumen feed.

endings.epilogue: The truth airs between two ads for Protein Paste. For one glorious quarter, nobody pays for air. {faction} stock crashes. You become a meme, then a legend, then a merchandise line.
You are now the {antagonist_title}. The view from the top floor is excellent. The air up here is free. For you.
It burns with a strange, honest light. Nothing changes overnight. But nobody can ever {scheme}. The Odd Duck flies on, slightly lighter.

bounty.title: Bounty: {target}
bounty.offer: "{target} has been squeezing this block dry. Paragon won't touch them - they pay their fees on time. You could, though."
bounty.done: "Gone? Really? Here - take this before I feel like an accomplice."

fetch.title: Lost & Found: {item}
fetch.offer: "I left {item} in a crate when the drones came. It's worth nothing to anyone but me. Please."
fetch.done: "You actually found it." They hold {item} like it might evaporate. "I owe you. Literally - here."

sabotage.title: Ad Blocker
sabotage.offer: "These billboards scream at my kids all night. Break {count} of them. I'll pay. Lumen won't know it was me."
sabotage.done: "Quiet. Actual quiet. I forgot what it sounds like."
